clips.title: The story
paras: In northwestern Ashenvale, the Ruins of Ordil'Aran lie between Maestra's Post and Bathran's Haunt. Thistlefur furbolgs have overrun the ancient night elf settlement, once a hidden refuge for shadow cultists.

Weathered pillars and cracked arches are all that remain of Ordil'Aran's Kaldorei buildings. The Cult of the Dark Strand once hid among the stones, ambushing travelers on Ashenvale's northwestern paths. Recently, Thistlefur furbolgs drove the cultists out in a bloody takeover. Fallen Dark Strand practitioners still litter the ground, while the furbolgs patrol the perimeter and guard the ancient Heartswood tree within the ruins.
